name: compromised-package-ioc
description: Blocks adding a known-malicious package version (npm, PyPI, crates, Go, RubyGems, Packagist manifests and lockfiles), a re-pointed action ref, or an IOC file name, from a dated, sourced list (data/ioc.json, CI fails 120 days after as_of). Runs: commit, agent write, turn's end; only additions judged. Exact versions only: a range is not resolved. A snapshot, not a feed; friction, not a boundary. Adopt under rollout observe. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo. In Cursor the turn's end is not held: a refusal there is handed back to the agent as a follow-up message, once, and a hook that fails to answer lets the turn end.]
